verdict.rationale: LangSmith documents framework integrations as a first-class way to add tracing. These include a native LangChain integration (corroborated by community as turnkey), a `wrap_openai` wrapper for the OpenAI SDK, and the Vercel AI SDK in its integrations list. A community note that it hardly works with CrewAI concerns a framework outside this story, so it does not undermine these three. Missing for 10: in-depth setup documentation for the Vercel AI SDK integration in the pack, and independent hands-on corroboration for the OpenAI and Vercel AI SDK integrations.

support.subject: As a developer, I can instrument my app through existing integrations for frameworks like LangChain, the OpenAI SDK, or the Vercel AI SDK

citations.quote: It works with any LLM Application, including a native integration with the LangChain Python and LangChain JS open source libraries.
Browse available integrations to connect your stack including OpenAI, Anthropic, CrewAI, Vercel AI SDK, Pydantic AI, and more.
Add tracing to your app in minutes with environment variables, framework integrations, or the SDK.
LangSmith is mainly built around the LangChain framework, so it's fairly turnkey
